purpose: Candidate pages for a 12+12 auditable mini KB. This file is not a source lock and must never be passed to formal ingestion.
formalization_required: Fetch each listed revision through its canonical revids API request with a descriptive User-Agent.

Store each raw response, a canonical HTTP acquisition receipt (raw SHA-256, status, final URI, HTTP Date, x-request-id, acquisition time, and every ETag or Last-Modified validator returned), and the deterministically derived canonical snapshot as three distinct regular files. If the origin returns neither validator, record validator_kind=none plus the exact absence reason; the fixed revision_id, response revision_sha1, raw SHA-256, and re-derived snapshot remain mandatory.
Human-review each fixed revision's footer, history, talk page, imported-text notices, and any additional attribution requirements.
Choose an exact non-empty wikitext character span, record start/end and SHA-256, and do not paraphrase or LLM-synthesize factual gold.

Create a canonical WikimediaSelectionLock containing 10-20 reviewed entries per track, binding all raw responses, acquisition receipts, canonical snapshots, license-evidence files, and the conservative permission matrix.

Create a canonical row-level human review ledger binding every page, revision, evidence span, approval decision, human reviewer, and review time; automated models may assist preparation but cannot approve their own selections.
Publish the two license-evidence file SHA-256 values and the human-review-ledger SHA-256 through independent caller-owned channels.
Publish the selection-lock SHA-256 through an independent caller-owned channel such as a reviewed config or CI secret; never derive it inside the formal builder.
Run build_wikimedia_kb_bundle offline against only the fixed snapshot directory and the externally pinned selection lock.
